result.title: ReXMo: End-to-End Video Character Replacement with Expression and Motion Preservation
result.summary: Video character replacement aims to replace actors while preserving facial expressions, motions, and scene dynamics. Existing methods typically rely on masked generation with pose guidance, limiting fine-grained expression and motion preservation in complex scenes. We propose ReXMo, an end-to-end framework that supports single-, multi-, and selective character replacement scenarios. ReXMo introduces paired triplet supervision, where synthesized driving videos and original videos share identical performances but different identities, enabling scalable training through synthetic data generation. An In-Context Diffusion Transformer learns identity transformation by jointly conditioning on driving videos, reference identities, and text prompts, while an Expression Enhancement Adapter improves facial expression preservation in multi-person scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReXMo outperforms existing methods in identity fidelity, motion consistency, expression preservation, and visual quality. Our dataset and code will be publicly released.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ReXMo 端到端视频角色替换框架，借助合成驱动视频与原视频构成的成对三元组监督，用 In-Context Diffusion Transformer 联合条件于驱动视频、参考身份和文本，并加表情增强适配器以保表情与动作。
AI.relevance_reason: 属视频人物替换/生成类工作，虽涉及身份与表情保持，但无内部推理状态、证据筛选或停止决策等机制，与 LVR 主线缺少具体可借鉴线索。
